# Return - Meditation Timer

> Minimal, zen-like meditation timer for Apple devices

## Overview

Return is a beautiful meditation timer app featuring immersive themes, Apple Health integration, and cross-device sync. Available for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac, and Apple TV.

## Key Features

- 4 Immersive Themes: Water, Fire, Forest, Silence
- Apple Health Integration: Heart rate, HRV, respiratory tracking
- Flexible Timing: 5-60 minute sessions
- 3 Bell Sounds: Gentle session markers
- Live Activities: Timer on Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
- iCloud Sync: Seamless across all devices

## Platforms

- iPhone and iPad
- Apple Watch (standalone)
- Mac (native)
- Apple TV

## Pricing

One-time purchase (no subscription). Basic timer free, unlock all themes and sounds with optional in-app purchase.

## Blog Content

250+ articles covering meditation techniques, mindfulness for athletes, sleep optimization, stress management, and health science.
